commentary.text: 90+5' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa was alert and made an amazing save!
89' The substitution has been made. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) has replaced Joao Gomes.
89' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Carlos Forbs (Wolves) replaces Nelson Semedo.
87' The attendance for today's match is 29341.
85' Danny Ward makes a world class save! Joao Gomes (Wolves) fires to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat the excellent goalkeeper.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jordan Ayew walks off the pitch to be replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester).
84' Vitor Pereira prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
83' Substitution. Craig Dawson (Wolves) has come on for Rodrigo Gomes.
82' Joao Gomes (Wolves) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
82' The ball finds it way to Jamie Vardy (Leicester) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.
81' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
77' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is replacing Goncalo Guedes.
73' Close! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
72' Wout Faes (Leicester) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul. Wolves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
70' A cross is whipped in towards Santiago Bueno (Wolves) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
67' The corner from Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) is intercepted by Jose Sa.
64' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leicester comes to nothing.
62' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Leicester will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
58' Good chance! Jamie Vardy (Leicester) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
54' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves).
53' It's time for a substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) comes on in place of Bilal El Khannouss.
53' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hamza Choudhury (Leicester) replacing James Justin.
53' Jose Sa (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
51' Jose Sa (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Jose Sa displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jamie Vardy (Leicester) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
49' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' Half-time substitution. Jannik Vestergaard will not participate anymore and Wout Faes (Leicester) is coming on.
46' The game is over for Oliver Skipp. Harry Winks (Leicester) comes on for the second half.
46' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' 0 - 3 Goncalo Guedes plays a neat ball into the path of Matheus Cunha (Wolves), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the left post! 0:3.
43' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
42' Danny Ward is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Goncalo Guedes (Wolves). Easy save!
38' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Anthony Taylor signals that there was no handball and the goal stands! The Wolves players celebrate.
38' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
36' 0 - 2 Matt Doherty plays a terrific cross over to Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
35' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
35' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
32' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
29' The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
29' The referee points to the corner flag and Leicester will take a corner.
28' A corner kick by Leicester is thwarted by the well prepared Jose Sa (Wolves).
26' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
25' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Jose Sa stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
24' James Justin (Leicester) tested Jose Sa with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
22' Jannik Vestergaard (Leicester) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

19' 0 - 1 Goal! Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot inside the left post. Nelson Semedo assisted in the goal. 0:1.
16' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
15' Joao Gomes (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
12' Dangerous play by Boubakary Soumare (Leicester). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Great touch by Jamie Vardy (Leicester) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
7' Joao Gomes (Wolves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
5' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
